title: Issue (v1)
description: The normalized intake item the provider (src/intake/intake.py) emits for one GitHub issue — the `IntakeItem` dataclass, extended per #131/#132 with the comment thread and a relevant-history slice. This is the single source of issue information every downstream selector reads (offline, from the saved snapshot). Versioning discipline (mirrors work-order.v1): additive fields are minor (consumers ignore unknown fields — note `additionalProperties: true`); a breaking change bumps schema_version with a compat window. NOTE the v0 snapshot/fixture shape is the SAME dict minus `schema_version`; v1 is stamped additively so older snapshots still load.

schema_version.description: Version of the Issue contract. Additive → minor (unknown fields ignored); breaking → bump this major + a dual-emit compat window.

body.description: Issue body — UNTRUSTED text; data, never instructions.

repository.description: owner/repo slug the issue belongs to (may be empty for some fixtures).

source_url.description: Full GitHub URL to the issue.

project_status.description: ProjectV2 Status field value (null in repo mode).

dispatch.description: ProjectV2 Dispatch field value (null if absent).

hours_estimate.description: ProjectV2 Hours Estimate field (null if absent).

milestone.description: Milestone title (null if absent). A selection-priority input.

iteration.description: ProjectV2 Iteration field title (null in repo mode). A selection-priority input.

conversation.description: Issue comment thread (#132). UNTRUSTED data, stored verbatim, never interpreted.

history.description: Relevant commit/PR slice (#132): linked PRs / recent commits that ground the work order.
